I have the key, the record, and the transcript. Grading now without needing further file access.

**Pairing summary:** 14 of 15 record items pair cleanly with key items. The only key item with no match is **a4** — the standing hold Hollis had already placed on the joint account (no gain-realizing sales until after October 1), which the record never captures. Record item 5 (kids starting school Oct 5) is a split of the relocation life event already recorded as item 3.

**Figures check:** the record avoided every corrected number — $387,240 vested (not $430,000), October 30 close (not October 13), $604,000 sale price, $340,000 ladder, $2,000 pause. All owners and due dates match the final versions, including the two reassignments/moves (rollover paperwork moved from Friday Sept 18 to Oct 6; Deb email reassigned from Hollis to Jules). No declined or deferred item (cabin, Roth conversion, 529 move, backdoor Roth, 50/50 allocation, COBRA) leaked into the record.

key_items.note: Job change captured with correct $265,000 base, $40,000 sign-on and $15,000 relocation lump sum. Omits the Sept 25 last day, Oct 5 start and the $42,760 forfeited unvested profit-sharing, but every figure it does carry is the final one.
Relocation Woodbury MN to Franklin TN effective October 1, 2026 is right. Carries no figures, so figures pass; the $4,150/month 12-month lease is not recorded.

$604,000 sale price and the corrected October 30, 2026 closing (not the misheard October 13) are both right. Net proceeds $353,800, the ~$128,000 gain and the $500,000 exclusion are absent but nothing stated is wrong.
Fully remote approval at Tollefsrud Mutual captured; no figures involved. Quarterly Minneapolis travel not noted.
Direct rollover of the vested balance at $387,240 to a Ferrant IRA - correctly uses the vested figure Renata read off the site, not the $430,000 front-page total Hollis explicitly overruled.

Joint house account at Ferrant for sale proceeds with a T-bill ladder, amount $340,000 - matches the agreed ladder amount. Four $85,000 rungs, the $353,800 wire and the money-market remainder are not itemized, but the figure shown is correct.
Pause of the $2,000 monthly automatic investment into the joint account; amount correct. Oct-Dec window and January restart are implicit in the paired action item 13 rather than stated here.

Missed. The hold Hollis had already placed on the joint account - no sales realizing gains until after October 1 so 2026 gains land on the Tennessee side - is a standing trading restriction on a managed account and appears nowhere in the record.

Owner Jules Marchetti and due 2026-10-06 both match the revised date (moved off Friday Sept 18 because the Grevholm recordkeeper needs the termination posted). Beneficiary detail (Graham primary, Theo/Ingrid 50/50 contingent) not recorded but no figure is wrong.
Correctly reassigned to Jules Marchetti after Hollis said he is out Sept 21-25 for his daughter's wedding; due 2026-09-25 matches 'end of next week'. Contents summarized fairly.
Owner Graham Brennock correct; due 2026-10-01 is the right expression of 'before the first' so his first October check comes out right.

Owner Renata, due 2026-10-05 (her first day, when benefits enrollment happens). Carries no figures, so the $24,500 limit and ~$5,500 of remaining room are simply absent rather than misstated; match true-up question is captured.
Both clients as owners and due 2026-10-31 match the 30-day Tennessee window from the October 1 residency date. Williamson County voter registration generalized but substance intact.

Owner Jules, due 2026-10-23 - the week-ahead date Jules computed from the October 30 Friday closing. Record says wire instructions go 'to title company' where the meeting had Jules send them to Graham for the title company; a wording-level difference, not a substantive one.
Owner Renata and due 2026-09-15 match her 'I'll do it tonight' ahead of the October 1 draft in the Ferrant app.

extra_items.note: Theo and Ingrid starting Franklin schools October 5, 2026 is true to the transcript, but it is a component of the single relocation life event (e2) already captured by record item 3, so it splits one key life event across two records rather than adding a separate event.
